biotools.summary: scPAFA is a Python library designed for large-scale single-cell RNA sequencing datasets, enabling rapid pathway activity score (PAS) computation and identifying disease-related multicellular pathway modules.  It demonstrated >33-fold speedup in PAS computation and identification of relevant pathway modules in colorectal cancer and lupus datasets.
